title: Office reception desk
summary: An L-shaped reception desk with a raised counter, a slatted front and a painted finish.
intro: A reception desk for an office in Brentwood. It is L-shaped, with a raised counter for visitors, a slatted front and a matching unit to one side. Everything was built and fitted in MDF first, then finished in a dark painted colour.

cover.alt: Dark painted L-shaped reception desk with a slatted front in front of a world map wall
